title: William Stout
description: "l believe that the Ewoks may have been inspired in part by the amazing African Pygmies," suggests Wiliam Stout. "I wanted to try to capture the dignity of one of the so-called primitive races that lives in harmony with nature, a harmony that thus far seems to elude our more 'civilized' society." Stout's breathtaking natural history studies have been exhibited in some of the world's most important museums. He's an internationally-known motion picture designer and an award-winning comics artist. Stout recently rendered the cover for an all-dinosaur issue of RAY BRADBURY COMICS (#1), for Topps.
